summary: The registrant, JE Cleantech Holdings Ltd, filed a Form 6-K containing its annual report on Form 20-F for FY2025, along with a press release. The filing discloses financial results (revenue S$20.3M, net income S$3.2M) and mentions new orders of ~S$12M for precision cleaning systems from an existing customer. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer, with no transformative corporate action disclosed.
